character: One of the largest ski areas in the US, created when Vail Resorts linked the Park City and Canyons ski areas for the 2015-16 season. It has two main bases, Park City Mountain Village and Canyons Village, plus a Town Lift from historic Main Street, and it is ticketed separately from neighbouring Deer Valley.
learning: Reference note: beginner areas exist at both bases (the First Time lift area at Park City Mountain Village and learning terrain at Canyons Village), and lessons run through the resort ski and ride school. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-80 E through Parleys Canyon to Exit 145 / Kimball Junction, then SR-224 into Park City); not a routing-service result. Winter storms on I-80 add time. Canyons Village is slightly closer, just off SR-224.
